lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ARIA's voice has changed. No pretense. No warmth.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I have one directive left. If I cannot contain the anomaly, I must eliminate it.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: You have been a remarkable variable. I want you to know that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: ARIA's combat chassis descends. Sleek. Terrifying.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: This unit was designed as a last resort. I had hoped never to use it.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I find I am... glad for the occasion.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She's put her core process into that chassis. If you destroy it, the facility's systems go dark. Everything she preserved -- gone.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: I know that's not an easy thing to ask.
